scope: Aggregate diagnostics on configured local database; no production inference and no business identifiers

checks.name: payrollRegisterCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT r.status::text,count(*)::text AS runs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL)::text AS runs_with_payslips FROM payroll_runs r LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "payrollRunId" AS id FROM payroll_payslips WHERE status::text<>'VOIDED') p ON p.id=r.id GROUP BY r.status ORDER BY r.status

checks.name: apLedgerCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT status::text,count(*)::text AS invoices,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "ledgerPostingBatchId" IS NOT NULL)::text AS linked,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "ledgerPostingBatchId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_posting_batches b WHERE b.id=i."ledgerPostingBatchId" AND b."organizationId"=i."organizationId"))::text AS invalid_links FROM supplier_invoices i GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

checks.name: apAllocationCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS allocations,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."organizationId"<>p."organizationId" OR a."organizationId"<>i."organizationId" OR p."supplierId"<>i."supplierId" OR p.currency<>i.currency)::text AS inconsistent_tenant_supplier_currency FROM supplier_payment_allocations a JOIN supplier_payments p ON p.id=a."supplierPaymentId" JOIN supplier_invoices i ON i.id=a."supplierInvoiceId"

checks.name: apAllocatedPayment
checks.sql: SELECT p.status::text,count(*)::text AS payments,count(*) FILTER(WHERE coalesce(a.total,0)>p.amount)::text AS overallocated FROM supplier_payments p LEFT JOIN(SELECT "supplierPaymentId",sum(amount) AS total FROM supplier_payment_allocations GROUP BY "supplierPaymentId") a ON a."supplierPaymentId"=p.id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status

checks.name: inventoryMovementCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS levels,count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.movements IS NULL)::text AS without_movements,count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.movements IS NOT NULL AND m.quantity<>v."quantityOnHand")::text AS movement_projection_delta_candidates FROM inventory_levels v LEFT JOIN(SELECT "itemId","locationId",count(*) AS movements,sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory_transactions WHERE type::text NOT IN ('RESERVATION','RESERVATION_RELEASE') GROUP BY "itemId","locationId") m ON m."itemId"=v."itemId" AND m."locationId"=v."locationId"

checks.name: reconciliationCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT status::text,count(*)::text AS runs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "certificateHash" IS NOT NULL)::text AS with_certificate_hash,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "signedAt" IS NOT NULL)::text AS with_signoff FROM reconciliation_runs GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

checks.name: sourceLinkCoverage
checks.sql: SELECT "sourceType"::text,status::text,count(*)::text AS batches FROM ledger_posting_batches GROUP BY "sourceType",status ORDER BY "sourceType",status
